Name: Phat Fly!
Overview:
You are Phat Fly, the meanest fly in town.

Customize yourself with hats, hair, and other accessories with money you find in-game.

Upgrade your character with G.U.B.E.R. items such as booger bazookas, bombs, and sheilds.

Battle and avoid tons of different enemies such as bats, toads and even a giant monkey!
